subject.title: feat(bootstrap-extra-files): opt-in allowCustomNames for extra bootstrap files

question: Should arbitrary custom-named system-prompt files become a supported option of the bundled core hook, or remain an operator-managed hook/plugin customization?
rationale: The repository policy sets a high bar for new config and directs optional behavior to existing extension seams when those seams are sufficient; code review cannot determine whether maintainers want to permanently support this additional trusted-prompt configuration contract.

options.title: Keep bundled hook narrow
options.body: Retain the recognized-name contract and route arbitrary operator-curated files through a documented managed hook or plugin package.

options.title: Sponsor the core option
options.body: Accept `allowCustomNames` as a supported bundled-hook contract after session filtering, public documentation, security wording, and real-runtime proof are completed.

recommendation.title: Keep bundled hook narrow
recommendation.body: Retain the recognized-name contract and route arbitrary operator-curated files through a documented managed hook or plugin package.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice sets core configuration and trusted prompt-context policy across the agent runtime.
